headline: Wade beats Ross Smith to win the Flanders Darts Trophy in Antwerp
standfirst: James Wade won European Tour 13, beating Ross Smith 8-4 in the final after a 101.59 average against Rob Cross in the last 16.
body: James Wade won the Flanders Darts Trophy at Antwerp Xpo, beating Ross Smith 8-4 in the final. Wade averaged 95.50 and Smith 94.82.
Wade's toughest match came in the last 16, where he averaged 101.59 to edge Rob Cross 6-5. He then whitewashed Danny Noppert 6-0 in the quarter-finals and beat Damon Heta 7-4 in the semi-finals.
Smith needed deciding legs in back-to-back matches. He edged Ryan Joyce 6-5 in the quarter-finals and Gian van Veen 7-6 in the semi-finals.
Kevin Doets produced the best average of the weekend, 106.24, but still lost 6-5 to Van Veen in the last 16. Nathan Aspinall averaged 105.99 against Niko Springer.
Wessel Nijman and Sebastian Bialecki both hit 170 checkouts. Wade led the 180 count with 18, ahead of Smith and Heta on 13 each.
